On top of the array of extras provided by the manufacturers,
we've added a few of our own — turning the A300 Airbus into the
A300 Superbus: Extra galleys, extra luggage lockers, extra
legroom, extra toilet, extra fuel economy and extra hostesses,
to give you even more of the service other airlines talk about.
• Length: 53.57m (175ft 9 ins) • Wing span: 44.84m (147ft 1 in)
• Tail height: 16.53m (54ft 3 ins) • Maximum take-off weight: 165,000 kg
(363,825 Ibs) • Maximum landing weight: 136,000 kg (299,880 Ibs)
• Operating empty weight: approximately 93,000 kg (205,065 Ibs)
• Maximum payload: approximately 31,000 kg (68,355 Ibs)
• Operational range (equivalent still air distance with full load):
3,340 nautical miles (6,185 km) • Cruise altitude: Average Flight Level
310 (9,448.8 m) • Cruise speed (still air speed): 458 knots
(848 km/hr) • Fuel capacity: 16,100 US gallons (47,500 kg)
• Engines: two General Electric CF6-50C2. Maximum thrust 23,814 kg
(52,500 Ibs) • Seating capacity: 24 First Class, 222 Economy
• Cabin features: 6 galleys, 6 toilets, central overhead baggage
compartments, coat stowage for First Class passengers,
individual reading lights and inflight music system.
• Navigational system: triplicated inertial navigational systems.
SIA's A300 SUPERBUS. THE ONE WITH THE EXTRAS.
